templates.name: NumPy
templates.description: NumPy is the foundation of numerical computing in Python. Covers arrays, broadcasting, linear algebra, random generation, and vectorised operations.

templates.name: Matplotlib
templates.description: Matplotlib is Python's core plotting library. Covers line charts, scatter plots, histograms, subplots, 3D surfaces, and annotations.

templates.name: Pandas
templates.description: Pandas is the go-to library for tabular data manipulation. Covers DataFrames, groupby, merging, time-series, missing data, and method chaining.

templates.name: Seaborn
templates.description: Seaborn builds on Matplotlib to produce statistical graphics with less code. Covers distribution plots, categorical charts, pair grids, heatmaps, and regression plots.

templates.name: Scikit-learn
templates.description: Scikit-learn is Python's standard machine learning library. Covers classification, regression, pipelines, cross-validation, and hyperparameter tuning.

templates.name: SciPy
templates.description: SciPy extends NumPy with scientific and engineering algorithms. Covers hypothesis testing, optimization, integration, curve fitting, and signal processing.
